title: Taiwan’s first F-16V fighter jets arrive to bolster defenses against China
summary: TAITUNG, Taiwan >> The first two of a batch of 66 new F-16V Block 70 fighter jets ordered in 2019 arrived in Taiwan today after months of delays, helping to strengthen an air force that has to scramble almost daily to shadow China’s military.
author: Reuters
